en-US.description:
RSC Shell is a small store you carry in your pocket. Browse the catalog, keep a cart that follows you from phone to browser, and look back at your orders.

• Photo search: point the camera at a product and the store finds it in the catalog.
• Passkeys: sign in with Face ID instead of a password.
• App lock: the app locks with Face ID when you leave it.
• One account everywhere: your cart and orders are the same on the web at rscmfe.sph.sh.

Every tab is built and shipped by its own team, so new features reach you without an app update.
en-US.promotionalText: Point your camera at a product and find it in the store. Sign in with a passkey, no password to remember.
